scanner.name: siemens_prisma_3t
scanner.cited: the body coil's peak B1 as Deelchand et al. 2021 (NMR Biomed 34:e4218) state it, the gradients from the vendor's specification (Prisma XR 80 mT/m, 200 T/m/s); the field from the COWS raw headers, 123.26 MHz

measured.statistic: the map's median in the wm cells past 0.95 of the partial volume (scan.maps.MapReading)

source.dataset: 3D radial multi-echo spin echo, Bordeaux, Zenodo 10908743 (CC BY 4.0)
source.citation: Corbin et al. 2025, Magn Reson Med 93:1026

records.processing: the EPG T2 map onto the tissues' grid by the affines, linear; the tissues FSL fast with the standard priors throughout on the first echo, inside MNI152's brain mask flirted onto it
records.note: one subject's EPG-fitted T2 (Anima, B1 and M0 fitted) of a 50-echo radial spin echo train, white matter only: the paper's Table 1 reads white matter 71.7 to 80.5 ms over its seven participants off their own MPRAGE; grey and CSF left to the literature
